why-diagnosticMessages: It is what lets the RequiresDocker fixture say out loud, at the DEFAULT `dotnet test` verbosity,
which Docker engine it is about to strip of the mainguard proxy and networks.
Measured (xunit 2.9.3 + xunit.runner.visualstudio 3.1.4, .NET 10): a fixture's Console output
reaches only --verbosity normal, while an IMessageSink DiagnosticMessage reaches both — and
disappears entirely when this flag is false. DockerSuiteDiagnosticsTests asserts the flag is still
true and still copied next to the test assembly, because the failure mode here is silence.
